_provenance.how: Constructed by hand from the documented Open-Meteo Flood API response shape (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/flood-api). NOT a live capture: this machine's Python cannot complete TLS to the API without truststore (docs/RUNBOOK.md section 3) and the test suite is zero-network by rule. Discharge values are typed to exercise the section 7.3.1 flood rule (a pulse: peak 163.8 m3/s against a weekly mean-of-means of ~62.3 m3/s, ratio ~2.63 >= 2.0); they are not a real GloFAS forecast for the Nyando or any other river.
